answer_1.quote: Inspired by its outstanding performance, researchers explored applying ICL on many tasks such as text summarization, sentiment classification, and linguistic acceptability.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates both understanding tasks (via close-ended evaluation) and generative tasks (e.g., summarization on Arxiv via open-ended evaluation).

answer_2.quote: We comprehensively evaluate the ICL performance of UniICL on the out-of-domain dataset CoLA, SST-2, and IMDb by close-ended evaluation and Arxiv by open-ended evaluation in Tab. 3.
